message.content:
It sounds like you’re asking who can hold the most hearts in a single hand of poker.  
In Texas Hold’em (the most common variant), each player can end up with **up to 7 hearts**—the two private cards plus the five community cards.  
So the “player with the highest number of hearts” is simply the one whose seven‑card hand contains the most hearts; the theoretical maximum is 7.
